decisions.statement: Where the player is is worked out once per map change rather than on every ask.
A map is named by tile texture as well as by id.
The lookups from name back to id are built as the game loads the library.
An add-on hears about a zone change through a callback rather than by asking.
The zone rows are the rows upstream LibMapData v1.21 states.
This library needs LibGPS loaded first.

definition: which map, zone and floor the player is on, and where that falls on Tamriel
